Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

and”→explicit_retention_permission；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_post_disposal_retention_effect_v1__33_37", "operation": "post_disposal_retention_effect_v1", "unit_ids": [33, 34, 37], "current_units": [{"id": 33, "text": "(e) Not disclose or in any way assist or permit the disclosure of any Confidential Information to any other person or entity without the express written consent of theauditee ; and"}, {"id": 34, "text": "(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor."}, {"id": 37, "text": "(g) Not to send Auditee’s audit information or data and/or any such Confidential Information at any time outside India for the purpose of storage, processing, analysis or handling without the express written consent of the Auditee."}]}]}
